bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 10 月 13 日低点

read.en: ASML fell 3.9% on Oct 14 to $1,650 on twice its usual volume, after failing at $1,734.5 near the 30-day average. It is below its 5-day ($1,733.6), 10-day ($1,784.3), 30-day ($1,731.1) and 100-day ($1,748.3) averages and 5% above the 200-day ($1,571.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,869.7), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 10月14日在 30 日均线附近的 $1,734.5 受阻后，以约两倍于平常的成交量下跌 3.9%，收于 $1,650。股价位于 5 日（$1,733.6）、10 日（$1,784.3）、30 日（$1,731.1）和 100 日均线（$1,748.3）下方，比 200 日均线（$1,571.4）高 5%。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,869.7），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The Oct 13 low ($1,682) broke and becomes first resistance, ahead of $1,731–1,748 (30 and 100-day averages) and $1,784 (10-day). The day's low was $1,648.8. Support is $1,619 (Sep 3 low), then $1,571–1,573 (Sep 14 low and 200-day average) and $1,531 (Jul 29 low). A close below $1,619 would open $1,572.
